items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that a versal formal object over R of a deformation situation can be transported to the changed residue field: there are a ring S in the category over the larger residue field with R -> S formally smooth in the adic topology inducing the field extension, and a versal formal object of the changed functor lying over S (statement lines 7692-7704). The proof (proof lines 7706-7753) constructs S as an adic completion of a polynomial ring over R, reduces to a smoothness statement using the stability of smoothness under change of residue field, and verifies the lifting property through formal smoothness. H2: a three-step construction with three inputs, written out in full.
